subject.title: Flaky tests on Windows/WSL: timeouts and ENOENT in pi-tools workspace-paths & safe-bins

question: Should https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/90273 stop claiming to close this issue, or should this issue be explicitly broadened to include its separate fs-safe hardlink-test work?
rationale: The PR's changed surface is distinct from the reported pi-tools failures, but its closing syntax prevents conservative automated cleanup and could close the wrong report when merged.

options.title: Remove the closing reference
options.body: Keep the PR scoped to fs-safe hardlink capability testing and allow this issue to close separately based on current-main non-reproduction evidence.

options.title: Broaden this issue explicitly
options.body: Retain the closing relationship only if maintainers intentionally redefine this issue as a broader Windows test-compatibility tracker and document that scope.

recommendation.title: Remove the closing reference
recommendation.body: Keep the PR scoped to fs-safe hardlink capability testing and allow this issue to close separately based on current-main non-reproduction evidence.

likelyOwner.reason: The supplied history and discussion show the strongest connection to both affected test files and the previous narrow-fix review.
